title: Pure Cloudian
summary: Cloudian cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Cloudians are WATER Fairies that can't be destroyed in battle but destroy themselves in face-up Defense Position. When Normal Summoned, most gain a Fog Counter for each Cloudian on the field, and they spend those counters on effects. Cirrostratus destroys a monster, Acid Cloud a Spell/Trap, and Altus discards from the opponent's hand. Cloudian - Turbulence spends a counter to summon Cloudian - Smoke Ball from the Deck or either GY, which builds the board for Links and Xyz. Cloudian - Storm Dragon summons itself by banishing a Cloudian from the GY and adds counters. Cloudian Aerosol, the newest card (2019), discards a Cloudian to load a monster with Fog Counters, then banishes itself and a Cloudian from the GY to summon one from the Deck. Summon Cloud revives a small Cloudian onto an empty field, and Lucky Cloud draws two after two same-name summons.
